name: In Loving Memory
source:
It's been a long time since Adi's last explored an abandoned building with her girlfriend, Frankie. But when she decides to come back one more time, she finds the house holds onto memories tighter than it should. Exploring these echoes of the past only seems to pull her in deeper. Can Adi escape with her love, or is the house's grip too tight?

[From [url=https://floramisu.itch.io/in-loving-memory]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
距离阿迪上一次与女友弗兰基一同探索废弃建筑，已经过去了很久。然而当她决定最后再重返故地一次时，却发现这栋老屋比想象中更紧地抓着过往记忆不放。追寻这些往昔的回响，似乎只会将她拖入更深的漩涡。阿迪能否带着挚爱逃出生天，还是老屋的桎梏早已牢不可破？

[摘自[url=https://floramisu.itch.io/in-loving-memory]itch.io[/url]]
